# Job Nexus HR

> Job Nexus HR (Job Nexus HR Private Limited) is a recruitment and staffing company based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India, founded in 2026. It helps employers across India hire and manage people — from a few specialist hires to hundreds of shift workers — and helps job seekers find genuine roles. Every client gets one named account manager who stays with them from the first brief through deployment and after day one. Tagline: "Better Talent. Brighter Futures."

Contact: info@jobnexushr.com · +91 96061 97196 · https://www.jobnexushr.com · Bengaluru, India
Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jobnexushr/ · https://www.instagram.com/jobnexushr/

## Services
- [Permanent Recruitment](https://www.jobnexushr.com/staffing/permanent-recruitment): specialist and mid-level hiring, managed from brief to onboarding by one account manager.
- [Volume Staffing](https://www.jobnexushr.com/staffing/volume-staffing): high-volume and blue-collar hiring (e.g. warehouse, logistics, retail, e-commerce, shift workers) with sourcing, screening, batch start dates and daily attendance reporting.
- [Managed Payroll](https://www.jobnexushr.com/payroll): workers employed on the Job Nexus HR payroll — salaries, PF and ESI contributions, attendance input and exits handled monthly.
- [Statutory Compliance](https://www.jobnexushr.com/staffing/compliance): PF, ESI, professional tax and labour paperwork kept audit-ready as part of the engagement.
- [Background Verification](https://www.jobnexushr.com/staffing/bgv): education, employment, address and reference checks before people join, tracked and reported back.
- [Workforce Management](https://www.jobnexushr.com/workforce-management): day-to-day support after people start — attendance, shift gaps, replacements, grievances and regular reviews.

## Industries served
IT & Technology, BFSI, Healthcare, Pharma, Manufacturing, Engineering, Automotive, Retail, E-commerce, Logistics & Supply Chain, Warehousing, FMCG, Hospitality, Travel, Telecommunications, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Media & Entertainment, Customer Support, BPO/KPO, Professional Services, Energy and Infrastructure. Details: https://www.jobnexushr.com/industries

## How it works for employers
1. Brief: share roles, numbers, locations and deadlines once.
2. Understand: the account manager learns how the work actually runs.
3. Match: screened and shortlisted candidates, with a reason for every name.
4. Start: offers, documents and checks completed before day one.
5. Support: attendance, payroll and grievances handled by the Job Nexus HR team.
6. Continue: regular reviews with the same people.
Start here: https://www.jobnexushr.com/employers or https://www.jobnexushr.com/contact

## For job seekers
A real person reads every application, roles are described honestly, and the same recruiter stays reachable after you join. Open roles: https://www.jobnexushr.com/jobs · Candidate help: https://www.jobnexushr.com/candidates
